title: Lightning Over SE Asia from the ISS (including a sprite)
description:
Cameras aboard the International Space Station captured this intense lightning storm as well as an elusive "red sprite" as it passed over Myanmar (Burma) and Malaysia. The sprite appears at the 6 second mark in this video.

To view still images of the sprite and to read more about this phenomenon, see http://earthobservatory.nasa.gov/IOTD/view.php?id=78487&src=youtube

The original animation is available from the Crew Earth Observations group at NASA's Johnson Space Center http://eol.jsc.nasa.gov/Videos/CrewEarthObservationsVideos/myanmar_iss_20120430/myanmar_iss_20120430HD_web.mov
